scope: One matched Linux CI evidence-retention comparison; real signatures/synthetic observation flags, no business/network TPS. Both paths warmed, same files/validation, count and identity digest equal.
measurementLimits: One paired elapsed sample, not statistical throughput evidence.
Retained heap delta is after GC while retained output is kept alive; runtime noise included; not peak RSS.
Both modes use shared current scanner; comparison isolates complete result retention versus count/digest consumption, not an old source-vs-new source network comparison.
